target_customer: Direct-to-consumer online merchants in Southeast Asia that pay for a checkout layer
problem: Shoppers in Southeast Asia face account creation, redirects and fragmented local payment methods at checkout, which loses sales. Arrow provides account-free checkout supporting many local payment methods on top of existing gateways.
business_model: Checkout-as-a-service for merchants, likely per-transaction fees (not stated by sources)
product_category: Checkout and payments orchestration for e-commerce

technical_complexity.rationale: Layer over many payment gateways and regional wallets across several countries, with PCI-style security and fraud concerns; standard engineering with integration breadth as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Merchant integrations add some stickiness, but gateways and platforms could add similar flows and the product depends on third-party gateways.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it in sources found; a regional payments company, Pomelo Group, acquired it in January 2025, reportedly largely for talent.

market_need_then: Southeast Asian e-commerce was growing quickly in 2021 and D2C brands sold through own sites and social channels with fragmented payment methods; one source estimates $25 to 30B of regional GMV flows through such channels.

branding.domain_note: Used arrowcheckout.com (could not be fetched in this session); many other companies named Arrow exist.

identity.logo: A plain 'A' mark per a profile listing

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; a common name shared with many Arrow companies, using a checkout suffix domain.

outcome_analysis: Arrow raised a $4.8M seed in April 2022 led by Sequoia Capital India, reported 100 merchants and 50+ payment methods across Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia, then was acquired by Pomelo Group in January 2025 on undisclosed terms, with founders joining Pomelo. Coverage frames the deal as largely a talent purchase, so it reads as a soft landing rather than a large exit. No later rounds found.
notes: YC directory lists Arrow as Active but The Paypers and other outlets report acquisition by Pomelo Group on 23 Jan 2025. Company site arrowcheckout.com did not resolve in this session, treated as unreachable (may be dead after acquisition). CB Insights total of 5.93M is unverified.
